summary.short: Decree 10.615/2021 regulates the PADIS semiconductor incentive regime under Law 11.484/2007 for enrolled Brazilian firms: zero or reduced taxes on goods, services and imports, a tax credit tied to R&D spending, R&D investment duties and sanctions. A 2026 amendment adds the Brasil Semicon programme (Law 14.968/2024).
summary.long: Decree 10.615/2021 regulates the PADIS semiconductor and display industry programme under Law 11.484/2007. Chapter I sets federal tax benefits for enrolled firms: zero rates for PIS/Pasep, Cofins and IPI on qualifying goods and services, reduced import duties, and a 100% income-tax reduction on qualifying device sales. A tax credit is calculated on prior-quarter R&D spending, multiplied by 2.62 and capped at 13.10% of the R&D base. The Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation grants enrolment for listed activities. Enrolled firms must invest at least 5% of gross revenue in R&D and file annual reports and audit opinions. Chapter V sets infractions and sanctions, including fines, suspension, impediment and cancellation. The 2026 amendment adds the Brasil Semicon programme under Law 14.968/2024, a management council and benefit periods to 31 December 2029.

notes: The text interleaves original 2021 wording with amendments by Decreto nº 11.456/2023 and Decreto nº 13.065/2026, often in parallel blocks; relations and entities follow the amended wording where it is marked. The header marks 'Vide Decreto nº 11.323, de 2022' and 'Repristinado pelo Decreto nº 11.374, de 2023', and the closing line says 'Este texto não substitui o publicado no DOU de 1º.2.2022'. Inconsistencies: art. 52 gives sunset dates of 31 Dec 2026 (2023 wording) and 31 Dec 2029 (2026 wording); art. 9-A has two versions (10 Jan 2022 and 31 Dec 2024); art. 1 and several other articles appear in two versions. Amended wording renames ministries, but references to the Secretaria Especial da Receita Federal under the Ministério da Economia remain in places. Empty target_instrument_id and lei/ticker values mean not in the registry or not verified.
